prompt:
Subject: stabilize, target meaning "安定する".

Composition: An adult adjusts a short chair leg with a fitted wooden wedge until all four feet rest evenly, making the formerly wobbling chair steady.

Style: Use references/invidious.png for style only: thick rounded dark-brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D shapes, restrained cartoon shading.

Framing: One compact composition filling 80–90% of the square; keep all subjects complete. No decorative frame, pedestal, or floating ornaments.

Output: 512×512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and gaps. No text, letters, numerals, speech bubbles, labels, branding, or watermark.
Style reference invidious.png only: friendly rounded 2D cartoon, thick dark-brown outlines, flat colors, restrained shading. A person steadies a wobbly table by tightening its leg while a cup on top becomes level.
en: The person stabilizes the wobbly table.
ja: 人がぐらつくテーブルを安定させています。
